newsitem.title: NEPAL: Earthquake rocks Nepal capital Kathmandu - agency.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake rocks Nepal capital Kathmandu - agency.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.8 on the open-ended Richter scale shook the capital city of Kathmandu early on Saturday, triggering panic among residents, the Press Trust of India (PTI) quoted state radio as saying.
The news agency quoted officials as saying reports of casualties had not yet been received.
PTI said the epicentre of the earthquake was at Yarsha in the Rasuwa district, 65 km (40 miles) north of the capital.
Officials said some buildings had been damaged.
